verdicts.reason: Both lose the dropper bottles and capsules, and both leave the brush-stroke backing floating empty in the middle with the title moved below it. That breaks the original's text-on-stroke lockup, and in both the subtitle wraps so that 'review' sits alone on the last line. B is slightly worse: 'Spa Utopia' crowds against the bottom of the glass jar, and about 40% of the canvas at the bottom is dead space. A keeps the headline clear of the jar, but its bottom fifth is still empty.
